recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5961 unless a future separate editorial decision chooses to reword display text that uses 'name' generically rather than as the obsolete element path.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive OO change request from the DSTU1 ballot cycle to change DiagnosticReport.name to DiagnosticReport.code, following the same rationale as the Observation.name to Observation.code change in FHIR-5276.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by 2015 commits 01ee11110912d333c25bf88ab428b6243675a394 and b9715055a095302f49da041634b06bd8e8c64ae8, both titled '#5961 change .name to .code'. Those commits changed the then-current DiagnosticReport spreadsheet, examples, value set naming, and related guide material from name to code. The current DiagnosticReport StructureDefinition still has committee note #5961 on DiagnosticReport.code.
additional_context: DiagnosticReport is active in source/fhir.ini. The current DiagnosticReport StructureDefinition defines DiagnosticReport.code, and the current DiagnosticReport search parameter bundle uses DiagnosticReport-code with expression DiagnosticReport.code. FHIR-5276, the Observation issue cited by FHIR-5961, is also Published/Persuasive and current Observation source uses Observation.code. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-5961 found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the requested rename is already reflected in active current source and git grep found no remaining DiagnosticReport.name path in the DiagnosticReport source.
